summary: Giresun province stands under the national framework of Turkey, and the source inventory records no Giresun-specific finding on trans rights: no local instrument, enforcement pattern, incident or institution for the province was identified. A trans visitor to Giresun is assessed under the national record for Turkey, which carries the full national layer.
tangentialFactors: The inventory holds one national overview of LGBTQ rights in Turkey and one entry for Giresun itself, and the Giresun entry records no usable finding. No adjacent or turbulence factor specific to the province — no local protest, prosecution, municipal measure or police practice — was documented, so no comparison between Giresun and other provinces can be drawn from the sources.
localsOnly: No resident-facing fact specific to Giresun was recorded: the sources document nothing about local healthcare provision, identity-document services, facilities, community organisations or municipal policy in the province. What applies to trans residents of Giresun is set out in the national record for Turkey.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether Giresun diverges from the national position in law or in practice is unresolved and not sourced. The inventory contains no Turkish-language or local Giresun material, no provincial court or governorate record, and no reporting on incidents in the province; the absence of a Giresun finding reflects the coverage of the sources rather than a demonstrated absence of risk.
